name: Western Downs Green Power Hub P/L

notable: 400 MW solar farm near Chinchilla, QLD — part of Neoen's Western Downs Green Power Hub. One of Queensland's largest solar installations in the Western Downs energy corridor.

eis_specs.notes: Neoen; 460 MWp DC / 400 MW AC; 72-cell bifacial modules on single-axis trackers; >1M panels; grid-forming inverters. Consented via Western Downs Regional Council MCU. See also powerlink.com.au/projects/western-downs-green-power-hub-connection-project.
